project_type: React 18 + TypeScript SPA, Vite 5, Tailwind CSS 3, Framer Motion, Zustand, React Router DOM 6. FastAPI backend (Python). Monorepo structure.
build_system: Vite 5 with @vitejs/plugin-react and vite-plugin-pwa. Build command: tsc && vite build. Dev server proxies /api/* to http://localhost:8000. No npm workspaces — web and api are separate apps.
test_framework: No test runner configured. No vitest/jest config found. Verification is build-only.
build_command: cd "j:\QUEUE CUT\apps\web" && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vite build
verification_instructions: 1. cd to j:\QUEUE CUT\apps\web. 2. Run: npx tsc --noEmit (must produce zero errors). 3. Run: npx vite build (must complete without errors). There are no automated tests; TypeScript type-check + successful Vite build is the verification gate.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory is generated by vite build. Do not commit it. It already exists in the repo.
environment_constraints: Windows path separators. PowerShell is NOT available — use cmd.exe or direct file tools. All absolute paths use j:\QUEUE CUT\... format. The dev API server is NOT running during build — do not make runtime API calls during build verification.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code style: functional components, named exports, Tailwind utility classes, Framer Motion for animations, Zustand for state. No class components. No Redux.
key_patterns: 1. Pages in src/pages/. Features (multi-component) in src/features/. Shared components in src/components/. 2. Data fetching: apiClient.ts wraps fetch with credentials:include. No React Query. 3. State: useAuthStore (user/session/trips/notifications), useUIStore (splash/onboarding flags), usePlannerStore (wizard), useExploreStore (park list). 4. CSS: Tailwind utilities + component classes in globals.css (@layer components). qc-page sets page container. 5. Routes: / → SplashPage, /onboarding → OnboardingPage, /login → LoginPage, /app/* → AppShell (nested). AppGuard checks hasSeenSplash + hasSeenOnboarding + sessionType. 6. Auth: cookie-based (queuecut_session). Google OAuth via /api/v1/auth/google/login redirect. Email via /api/v1/auth/register and /api/v1/auth/login.
directory_structure: apps/web/src/: App.tsx (root router), main.tsx (entry), layouts/ (AppShell), pages/ (one file per route), features/ (auth|calendar|home|itinerary|parks|planner|results|settings|trips|wizard - multi-component features), components/ (atoms|chat|destination|fasttrack|feedback|intelligence|layout|maps|molecules|notifications|organisms|recommendation|weather), hooks/, services/ (apiClient.ts, endpoints/), store/slices/ (authStore|exploreStore|plannerStore|uiStore), styles/ (globals.css|index.css), types/ (api.ts). apps/api/app/: main.py, api/routes/ (auth|parks|recommendation|trips|notifications|itinerary|telemetry|chat|feedback|news|download), core/config.py.
